name: description-lists
description: The anchor for a description list's vertical rhythm and for the two-column geometry of a horizontal one. The renderer gives the LAST description no bottom margin and lets the list itself carry the trailing space, so a preview that opens both leaves a full extra line under every description list; and a horizontal list is a two-column layout the renderer computes from the widest term, capped at half the measure, with both columns top-aligned — none of which a browser's default table layout does.
